i.norm: Verifies that comparing a 2-character null-char sequence against a 6-character null-char sequence yields the expected Jaro-Winkler similarity (~0.822). The shorter sequence ("\0\0") shares all its characters with the longer one ("\0\0\0\0\0\0"), but the length difference reduces the score below 1.0.
"\0\0" — two null characters (capacity-2 allocated buffer, all zeroed)
"\0\0\0\0\0\0" — six null characters (backed by a zeroed char array)
